components.name: Switch
components.description: On/off control in a Field row; amber track when on.
components.css: .ds-switch-row { display: flex; gap: 16px; background: #1C1917; padding: 16px; } .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 42px; height: 22px; border: none; border-radius: 11px; background: #3A3532; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; } .ds-switch span { position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: #FAFAF9; transition: left 150ms ease-out; } .ds-switch:hover { background: #57534E; } .ds-switch.on { background: #F59E0B; } .ds-switch.on span { left: 23px; background: #1C1917; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F59E0B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: Every one-of-several choice; the picked option wears the amber ceiling bar.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 36px; padding: 3px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #0F0D0C; border: 1px solid #3A3532; border-radius: 7px; width: 260px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-seg-opt { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 52px; border: none; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: #A8A29E; font: 400 12px inherit; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-opt:hover { background: #292524; } .ds-seg-opt.picked { background: #332E2B; color: #FAFAF9; font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg-opt.picked::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; top: 2px; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: #F59E0B; } .ds-seg-opt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F59E0B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chip toggle
components.description: A tick that reads as a card: what a section shows (a limit, a drive).
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; background: #1C1917; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex: 1; min-width: 132px; height: 54px; padding: 0 16px 0 12px; background: #292524; border: 1px solid #3A3532; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-family: inherit; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #332E2B; } .ds-chip.on { border-color: #57534E; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F59E0B; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tick { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 4px; border: 1.5px solid #A8A29E; } .ds-chip.on .ds-tick { background: #F59E0B; border: none; } .ds-chip-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; } .ds-chip-text b { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #A8A29E; } .ds-chip.on .ds-chip-text b { color: #FAFAF9; } .ds-chip-text small { font-size: 11px; color: #A8A29E; }

components.name: Field row
components.description: A setting across the page: label and note left, control right.
components.html:
Start with Windows
Launch Headroom when you sign in.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; min-height: 54px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 9px 12px 9px 16px; background: #292524; border: 1px solid #3A3532; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field > div { flex: 1; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; color: #FAFAF9; } .ds-field-note { font-size: 11px; color: #A8A29E; margin-top: 1px; } .ds-field-ctl { width: 42px; height: 22px; border-radius: 11px; background: #F59E0B; }

components.name: Rail item
components.description: Section navigation in the 220px deck-coloured rail, with a live value.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 220px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 14px; background: #0F0D0C; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-rail-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; height: 38px; padding: 0 12px 0 10px; border: none; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: #FFFFFF0A; } .ds-rail-item.sel { background: #292524; } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F59E0B; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rail-mark { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 4px; background: #FAFAF9; } .ds-rail-item.sel .ds-rail-mark { background: #F59E0B; } .ds-rail-item.off .ds-rail-mark { background: #A8A29E; } .ds-rail-name { flex: 1; text-align: left; font-size: 13px; color: #FAFAF9; } .ds-rail-item.sel .ds-rail-name { font-weight: 600; } .ds-rail-item.off .ds-rail-name { color: #A8A29E; } .ds-rail-val { font-size: 12px; color: #A8A29E; }

components.name: Style tile
components.description: One style shown as the section rendered that way; picked tile wears the amber ceiling bar.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: flex; gap: 12px; background: #1C1917; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-tile { position: relative; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 14px 12px 12px; background: #292524; border: 1px solid #3A3532; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-family: inherit; } .ds-tile:hover, .ds-tile.sel { background: #332E2B; } .ds-tile.sel { border-color: #57534E; } .ds-tile.sel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; top: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 1.5px; background: #F59E0B; } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F59E0B; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tile-art { display: grid; place-items: center; height: 76px; margin-bottom: 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #202020; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 14px; } .ds-tile b { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #FAFAF9; } .ds-tile small { font-size: 11px; color: #A8A29E; }

components.name: Preview strip
components.description: The live widget on the user's taskbar colour; the edited section wears a sliding amber ceiling bar; hidden sections wait as dimmed + slots.
components.html: Claude 42%RAM 61%+ CPU
components.css: .ds-deck { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 38px 16px; background: #0F0D0C; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: #202020; } .ds-spot { position: relative; padding: 14px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-spot:hover:not(.sel), .ds-ghost:hover { background: #FFFFFF14; } .ds-spot.sel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; top: -4px; height: 3px; border-radius: 1.5px; background: #F59E0B; transition: left 180ms ease-out, right 180ms ease-out; } .ds-ghost { width: 70px; padding: 14px 0; text-align: center; border-left: 1px solid #FFFFFF26; border-radius: 6px; color: #A8A29E; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview:
The settings window is the taskbar widget blown up and laid open. A live replica of the user's own taskbar sits in a dark deck at the top; it is both the preview and the navigation. Every choice below it is shown as the render it produces, not described in a checkbox list. The world is Ember, the same charcoal-and-amber palette as the Headroom mark: warm near-black stone surfaces in three depths, one off-white for text, and amber reserved for "this one" and "on".

Density is moderate desktop-tool density: 13px body, 54px rows, 8px card corners, one font family. Depth comes from tonal steps of the stone ramp and 1px hairlines, never shadows. The mark's ceiling bar (a thin amber rule) is the system's single signature: it sits over whatever is selected, in the preview, on a style tile, on a segment.

The window refuses the category default of a grey sidebar over stacked checkbox pages, and it refuses the generic Windows dialog look: even the title bar is painted charcoal.
keyCharacteristics: One live preview that doubles as navigation.
Three stone depths (deck, ground, raised) separated by hairlines; flat, no shadows.
Amber only for selection and on-states, shown as a ceiling bar, a filled tick or a filled switch.
Choices are rendered, not described: style tiles carry the real section art.
One family, Segoe UI Variable, Display cut for page titles only.

rules.name: The Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Amber marks "this one" or "on" and nothing else. A selection is shown by an amber ceiling bar on the element's top edge (2-3px tall, inset from the corners); an on-state by an amber fill. No amber text, no amber headings, no amber decoration.

rules.name: The Real Taskbar Rule
rules.body: The preview and every rendered choice sit on the user's actual taskbar colour, never on an Ember surface, because the point is to show what they will really see.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Segoe UI Variable throughout; the Display optical cut appears only at 22px page titles.

rules.name: The Stone Steps Rule
rules.body: Elevation is a lighter stone step plus a hairline, never a shadow or glow.

rules.name: The Dim, Don't Hide Rule
rules.body: When a section is off, its settings stay visible and usable at 0.7 opacity; in the preview it waits at the strip's end as a muted "+ Name" slot. Nothing disappears because it is off.

dos: Do show a choice as the render it produces (a style tile, the live preview), not as a sentence.
Do mark selection with the amber ceiling bar on the element's top edge, and on-states with an amber fill.
Do build depth from the stone steps (deck, ground, raised, raised-hover) plus 1px hairlines.
Do use the Segmented control for every one-of-several choice and the Switch for every on/off row.
Do dim off sections' settings to 0.7 opacity and keep them operable.
Do keep every pressable keyboard-reachable with the 2px amber focus ring 3px outside the element.
Do keep the "Unofficial. Not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI." line in the rail footer.
donts: Don't use amber for text, headings or decoration; it means selected or on.
Don't use shadows or glows for elevation.
Don't stack long checkbox lists; options that a section shows are chip toggles in one row.
Don't add a second typeface or uppercase labels; hierarchy is size and weight within Segoe UI Variable.
Don't put the Claude or OpenAI marks in Headroom's own branding (rail Logo, title bar icon); they identify sections only.
Don't let the window fall back to system grey chrome; the title bar is charcoal.
